fixes: Console CRTs: all 14 scopes show the same sine trace; the reference has varied content (polar plots, columns of telemetry, a radar sweep). Give each scope its own texture.
Wall display: the world map is too bright and flat; it should glow from behind with darker ocean areas and thin orbit ground tracks.
Desk clutter: binders and teleprinter paper read as clean grey boxes; add page edges, curl and print.
Haze is too uniform; the reference has denser smoke near the ceiling lit by the screens.
Chairs: three swivel chairs intersect the console fronts in the second row.
critiques.summary: Right room, right layout and camera. It falls down on the screens, which carry this reference, and on generic clutter.

fixes: Wall display: ground tracks are there but the telemetry panels either side are blank; the reference has columns of stencilled data.
Two scopes on the hero console are out of focus compared with the rest; sharpen or raise their emission.
Window reflections: the glass shows no reflection of the room; add a faint reflection so it reads as glass at night.
critiques.summary: Big improvement on the screens and the haze. The side panels of the wall display are the last thing that reads as unfinished.

fixes: Optional: a little more variation in console paint wear between rows.
Optional: one or two lit cigarettes in the ashtrays would add life to the haze.
critiques.summary: Passes. A faithful, photoreal version of the reference; the screens and the wall display now carry it.
